reference_target: User-supplied DOS executable; pinned JJFFE is a code helper with known patches, not automatically behavior-equivalent.
method: Static source/consumer inspection and read-only metadata of existing independent fixtures. No newly executed oracle, test, APK, binary-wide semantic equivalence, or physical-device claim. Function call index is not a completeness or understanding score.

source_frame_native.scope: Whole F572/F573 rotation primitives and composed native roundtrips; no automatic FOR selection, parent-origin translation or angular surface-velocity adjustment

source_gravity_native.scope: Complete pinned F603 velocity/fraction update with actual F1532 parent lookup, F880 coefficient slice, complete F1511 and F1512 position integration. No complete world physics/frame selection, surface radius, source timer or SI bridge claim.
